abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the diagnostic performance of refractive edge shadow in evaluation of ovarian dermoids compared to other benign adnexal masses. METHODS: Ultrasound images of 139 patients with 154 dermoids, endometriomas, and hemorrhagic cysts were retrospectively reviewed by 3 radiologists blinded to final diagnosis. Ultrasound and clinical features were compared to pathology or follow-up ultrasound results as reference standard. Inter-reader agreements with free-marginal kappa and diagnostic performance were evaluated. The former was compared using Fisher's exact test or Mann-Whitney test with p < 0.05 to determine statistical significance. RESULTS: The study sample consisted of 154 lesions: 50 dermoids, 50 endometriomas, and 54 hemorrhagic cysts. Refractive edge shadow, homogeneous echogenic appearance, tip of the iceberg sign, mural echogenic nodule, echogenic shadowing focus, and dot-dash sign all were statistically significant across all readers for the diagnosis of dermoid. Prevalence of each feature in dermoids compared to other entities were as follows: refractive edge shadow (70% vs 8%; p < 0.001), homogeneously echogenic appearance (34% vs 2%; p < 0.001), tip of the iceberg sign (16% vs 1%; p < 0.001), mural echogenic nodule (38% vs 2%; p < 0.001), echogenic shadowing focus (13% vs 1%; p < 0.001), and dot-dash sign (44% vs 1%; p < 0.001). Refractive edge shadow had the highest sensitivity, negative predictive value, and accuracy among all ultrasound features associated with dermoids (70%, 86%, and 85%, respectively). CONCLUSION: Refractive edge shadow is a promising ultrasound feature for diagnosis of dermoids, with the highest diagnostic accuracy and prevalence compared to other previously described features associated with dermoids.
abstract_ja: 目的：良性付属器腫瘤の中で卵巣皮様嚢腫を評価する際のrefractive edge shadowの診断能を評価すること。方法：皮様嚢腫、子宮内膜症性嚢胞、出血性嚢胞の計139例・154病変の超音波画像を、最終診断を知らされていない3名の放射線科医が後方視的に読影した。参照基準は病理結果またはフォローアップ超音波の結果とした。読影者間一致はfree-marginal kappaで評価し、診断能を算出した。前者はFisherの正確検定またはMann-Whitney検定で比較し、p < 0.05を統計学的に有意とした。結果：対象は154病変（皮様嚢腫50例、子宮内膜症性嚢胞50例、出血性嚢胞54例）であった。refractive edge shadow、均一な高エコー像、tip of the iceberg sign、壁在高エコー結節、高エコー性シャドーイングの焦点、dot-dash signは、全読影者において皮様嚢腫の診断に統計学的に有意であった。他の病変と比較した皮様嚢腫での各所見の有病率は、refractive edge shadow 70% vs 8%（p < 0.001）、均一な高エコー像 34% vs 2%（p < 0.001）、tip of the iceberg sign 16% vs 1%（p < 0.001）、壁在高エコー結節 38% vs 2%（p < 0.001）、高エコー性シャドーイングの焦点 13% vs 1%（p < 0.001）、dot-dash sign 44% vs 1%（p < 0.001）であった。Refractive edge shadowは、皮様嚢腫に関連する超音波所見の中で最も高い感度、陰性的中率、正確度を示した（それぞれ70%、86%、85%）。結論：Refractive edge shadowは皮様嚢腫の診断に有望な超音波所見であり、これまでに報告された他の所見と比べて最も高い診断精度と有病率を示した。
